scripts.db:setup: prisma migrate dev --name init && node prisma/seed.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix mini-app && npm install --prefix admin-panel
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,MINIAPP,ADMIN -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run dev --prefix mini-app" "npm run dev --prefix admin-panel"
